ja532:1.1: Devatā nu si gandhabbo adu Sakko purindado manussabhūto iddhimā, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ti.
ja532:2.1: N' amhi devo na gandhabbo na pi Sakko purindado, manussabhūto idhimā, evaṃ jānāhi Bhāratā 'ti.
ja532:3.1: Katarūpam idaṃ bhotā veyyāvaccaṃ anappakaṃ: devamhi vassamānamhi anvāvassaṃ bhavaṃ akā.
ja532:4.1: Tato vātātāpe ghore sītacchāyaṃ bhavaṃ akā, tato amittamajjhesu suratānaṃ bhavaṃ akā.
ja532:5.1: Tato phītāni raṭṭhāni vasino te bhavaṃ akā, tato ekasataṃ khatte anuyutte bhavaṃ akā.
ja532:6.1: Patīt' assu mayaṃ bhoto, vara taṃ bhañ ñam icchasi, hatthiyānaṃ assarathaṃ nāriyo ca alaṃkatā nivesanāni rammāni mayaṃ bhoto dadāmase.
ja532:7.1: Atha [vā] Aṅge vā Magadhe [vā] mayaṃ bhoto dadāmase, atha vā Assakāvantiṃ sumanā damma te mayaṃ.
ja532:8.1: Upaḍḍhaṃ vāpi rajjassa mayaṃ bhoto dadāmase sace te attho rajjena, anusāsa yad icchasīti.
ja532:9.1: Na me attho hi rajjena nagarena dhanena vā, atho pi janapadena attho mayhaṃ na vijjatīti.
ja532:10.1: Bhoto ca raṭṭhe vijite araññe atthi assamo, pitā mayhaṃ janettī ca ubho sammanti assame.
ja532:11.1: Tes' āhaṃ pubbacariyesu puññaṃ na labhāmi kātave, bhavantaṃ ajjhācāraṃ katvā Sonaṃ yācāmu saṃvaran ti.
ja532:12.1: Karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi brāhmaṇa, etañ ca kho no akkhāhi kīvanto bhontu yācakā ti.
ja532:13.1: Parosataṃ jānapadā mahāsālā ca brāhmaṇā ime ca khattiyā sabbe abhijātā yasassino bhavañ ca rājā Manojo alaṃ hessanti yācakā ti.
ja532:14.1: Hatthī asse ca yojentu rathaṃ sannayha naṃ rathi, ābandhanāni gaṇhātha pādās' ussārayaṃ dhaje, assaman taṃ gamissāmi yattha sammati Kosiyo
ja532:15.1: ti. Tato ca rājā pāyāsi senāya caturaṅginī, agamā assamaṃ rammaṃ yattha sammati Kosiyo ti
ja532:16.1: Kassa kādambayo kāco vehāsaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ aṃsaṃ asamphusaṃ eti udahārassa gacchato ti g. ā.
ja532:17.1: Ahaṃ Sono mahārāja tāpaso sahitaṃvato, bharāmi mātāpitaro rattindivam atandito.
ja532:18.1: Vane phalañ ca mūlañ ca āharitvā disampati posemi mātāpitaro pubbekatam anussaran
ja532:19.1: ti. Icchāma assamaṃ gantuṃ yattha sammati Kosiyo, maggaṃ no Sona akkhāhi yena gacchemu assaman ti.
ja532:20.1: Ayaṃ ekapadī rāja yen' etaṃ meghasannibhaṃ koviḷārehi sañchannaṃ, ettha sammati Kosiyo
ja532:21.1: ti. g. ā. Idaṃ vatvāna pakkāmi taramāno mahāisi vehāsi antalikkhasmiṃ anusāsitvāna khattiye.
ja532:22.1: Assamaṃ parimajjitvā paññāpetvāna āsanaṃ paṇṇasālaṃ pavisitvā pitaraṃ paṭibodhayi:
ja532:23.1: Ime āyanti rājāno abhijātā yasassino, assamā nikkhamitvāna nisīda tvaṃ mahāise.
ja532:24.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā taramāno mahāisi assamā nikkhamitvāna paṇṇadvāramhi upāvisīti.
ja532:25.1: Tañ ca disvāna āyantaṃ jalanta-r-iva tejasā khattasaṃghaparibbūḷhaṃ Kosiyo etad abravi:
ja532:26.1: Kassa bherī mutiṅgā ca saṃkhā paṇavadeṇḍimā purato paṭipannāni hāsayantā rathesabhaṃ.
ja532:27.1: Kassa kañcanapaṭṭena puthunā vijjuvaṇṇinā yuvā kalāpasannaddho, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:28.1: Ukkāmukhe pahaṭṭhaṃ va khadiraṅgārasannibhaṃ mukhaṃ cāru r-ivābhāti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:29.1: Kassa paggahitaṃ chattam sasalākaṃ manoramaṃ ādiccaraṃsāvaraṇaṃ. ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:30.1: Kassa aṃkaṃ pariggayha vālavījaniṃ uttamaṃ carati varapaññassa hatthikkhandhena āyato.
ja532:31.1: Kassa setāni chattāni ājānīyā ca vammitā samantā parikiranti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:32.1: Kassa ekasataṃ khatyā anuyuttā yasassino samantā anupariyanti, ko ceti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:33.1: Hatthiassarathapattisenāya caturaṅginī samantā anupariyāti, ko eti siriyā jalaṃ.
ja532:34.1: Kass' esā mahatī senā, piṭṭhito anuvattati akkhobhaṇī apariyantā sāgarasseva ūmiyo.
ja532:35.1: Rājābhirājā Manojo Indo va jayataṃ pati Nandass' ajjhāvaraṃ eti assamaṃ brahmacārinaṃ.
ja532:36.1: Tass' esā mahatī senā piṭṭhito anuvattati akkhobhaṇī apariyantā sāgarasseva ūmiyo ti.
ja532:37.1: Anulittā candanena kāsikavatthadhārino sabbe pañjalikā hutvā isīnam ajjhupāgamun ti.
ja532:38.1: Kacci nu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ, Kacci uñchena yāpetha, kacci mūlaphalā bahū.
ja532:39.1: Kacci ḍaṃsā ca makasā ca appam eva siriṃsapā, vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe kacci hiṃsā na vijjatīti
ja532:40.1: Kusalaṃ c' eva no rāja atho rāja anāmayaṃ, atho uñchena yāpema, atho mūlaphalā bahū,
ja532:41.1: Atho ḍaṃsā ca makasā ca appam eva siriṃsapā, vane vīḷamigākiṇṇe biṃsā amhaṃ na vijjati.
ja532:42.1: Bahūni c' assa pūgāni assame sammataṃ idha, nābhijānāmi uppannaṃ ābādhaṃ amanoramaṃ.
ja532:43.1: Svāgatan te mahāraja atho te adurāgataṃ, (IV 434|5) issaro si anuppatto, yaṃ idh' atthi pavedaya:
ja532:44.1: Tiṇḍukāni piyālāni madhuke kāsumāriyo phalāni khuddakappāni, bhuñja rāja varaṃ varaṃ.
ja532:45.1: Idam pi pānīyaṃ sītaṃ ābhataṃ girigabbharā, tato piva mahārāja sace tvaṃ abhikaṃkhasi.
ja532:46.1: Paṭiggahītaṃ yaṃ dinnañ ca sabbassa agghiyaṃ kataṃ, Nandassāpi nisāmetha vacanaṃ yaṃ so pavakkhati.
ja532:47.1: Ajjhāvar' amha Nandassa bhoto santikam āgatā, suṇātu bhavaṃ vacanaṃ Nandassa parisāya cā 'ti
ja532:48.1: Parosataṃ janapadā mahāsālā ca brāhmaṇā ime ca khattiyā sabbe abhijātā yasassino bhavañ ca rājā Manojo anumaññantu me vaco.
ja532:49.1: Ye hi santi samītāro yakkhāni idha assame araññe bhūtabhavyāni suṇantu vacanaṃ mama.
ja532:50.1: Namo katvāna bhūtānaṃ isiṃ vakkhāmi subbataṃ: so ty-āhaṃ dakkhiṇo bāhu tava Kosiya sammato.
ja532:51.1: Pitaram me janettiñ ca bhattukāmassa me sato vīra puññam idaṃ ṭhānaṃ, mā maṃ Kosiya vāraya.
ja532:52.1: Sabbhi h' etaṃ upaññātaṃ, mam' etaṃ upanissaja, uṭṭhānapāricariyāya dīgharattaṃ tayā kataṃ, mātāpitusu puññāni mama lokadado bhava.
ja532:53.1: Tath' eva santi manujā dhamme dhammapadaṃ vidū maggo saggassa lokassa yathā jānāsi tvaṃ ise.
ja532:54.1: Uṭṭhānapāricariyāya mātāpitusukhāvahaṃ taṃ maṃ puññ'ābhivāreti ariyamaggavaro naro ti.
ja532:55.1: Suṇantu bhonto vacanaṃ bhātur ajjhāvarā mama: kulavaṃsaṃ mahārāja porāṇaṃ parihāpayaṃ adhammacāri jeṭṭhesu nirayaṃ so upapajjati.
ja532:56.1: Ye ca dhammassa kusalā poraṇassa disampati cārittena ca sampannā na te gacchanti duggatiṃ.
ja532:57.1: Mātāpitā ca bhātā ca bhaginī ñātibandhavā sabbe jeṭṭhassa te bhārā, evaṃ jānāhi Bhārata.
ja532:58.1: Ādiyitvā garuṃ bhāraṃ nāviko viya ussahe, dhammañ ca na-ppamajjāmi, jeṭṭho c' asmi rathesabhā 'ti.
ja532:59.1: Adhigat' amha tame ñāṇaṃ jālaṃ va jātavedato evam eva no bhavaṃ dhammaṃ Kosiyo pavidaṃsayi.
ja532:60.1: Yathā udadhim ādicco vāsudevo pabhaṃkaro pāṇinaṃ pavidaṃseti rūpaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ evaṃ eva no bhavaṃ dhammaṃ Kosiyo pavidaṃsayīti.
ja532:61.1: Evaṃ me yācamānassa añjaliṃ nāvabujjhasi, tava baddhañcaro hessaṃ vuṭṭhito paricārako ti.
ja532:62.1: Addhā Nanda vijānāsi saddhammaṃ sabbhi desitaṃ, ariyo ariyasamācāro, bāḷhaṃ tvaṃ mama ruccasi.
ja532:63.1: Bhavantaṃ vadāmi bhotiñ ca suṇotha vacanaṃ mama: nāyaṃ bhāro bhāramato ahu mayhaṃ kudācanaṃ.
ja532:64.1: Taṃ maṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ santaṃ mātāpitusukhāvahaṃ Nando ajjhāvaraṃ katvā upaṭṭhānāya yācati.
ja532:65.1: Yo ve icchati kāmena santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ Nandaṃ vo vadatha eke kam Nando upatiṭṭhatū
ja532:66.1: ti. Tayā tāta anuññātā Sona taṃ nissitā mayaṃ, upaghātuṃ labhe Nandaṃ muddhani brahmacārinan ti g. ā.
ja532:67.1: Assatthasseva taruṇaṃ pavāḷaṃ māluteritaṃ cirassaṃ Nandaṃ disvāna hadayaṃ me pavedhati.
ja532:68.1: Yadā suttāpi suppante Nandaṃ passāmi āgataṃ udaggā sumadā homi: Nando no āgato ayaṃ.
ja532:69.1: Yadā ca paṭibujjhitvā Nandaṃ passāmi nāgataṃ bhiyyo āvisatī soko domanassañ cānappakaṃ.
ja532:70.1: Sāhaṃ ajja cirassam pi Nandaṃ passāmi āgataṃ, bhattuc-ca mayhañ ca piyo Nando no pāvisī gharaṃ.
ja532:71.1: Pitu pi Nando suppiyo, Yaṃ Nando pāvisī gharaṃ labhatu tāta Nando taṃ: maṃ Nando upatiṭṭhatū 'ti.
ja532:72.1: Anukampakā patiṭṭhā ca pubbe rasadadī ca no maggo saggassa lokassa mātā taṃ varate ise.
ja532:73.1: Pubbe rasadadī gottī mātā puññūpasaṃhitā maggo saggassa lokassa mātā taṃ varate ise ti.
ja532:74.1: Ākaṃkhamānā puttaphalaṃ devatāya namassati nakkhattāni ca pucchati utusaṃvaccharāni ca.
ja532:75.1: Tassā utusinātāya hoti gabbhass' avakkamo, tena dohaḷinī hoti, suhadā tena vuccati.
ja532:76.1: Saṃvaccharaṃ vā ūnaṃ vā pariharitvā vijāyati, tena sā janayantī (add ti), janettī tena vuccati.
ja532:77.1: Thanakhīrena gitena aṅgapāpuraṇena ca rodantaṃ (add: eva) toseti, tosentī tena vuccati.
ja532:78.1: Tato vātātape ghore mamiṃkatvā (add: va- dārakaṃ appajānantaṃ (add: poseti), posentī tena vuccati.
ja532:79.1: Yañ ca mātu dhanaṃ hoti yañ ca hoti pitū dhanaṃ ubhayam etassa gopeti, api puttassa no siyā.
ja532:80.1: Evaṃ putta adū putta iti mātā vihaññati, pamattaṃ paradāresu nisīthe pattayobbane sāyaṃ puttaṃ anāyantaṃ iti mātā vihaññati.
ja532:81.1: Evaṃ kicchā bhato poso mātu aparicārako mātari micchā caritvāna nirayaṃ so upapajjati.
ja532:82.1: Evaṃ kicchā bhato poso pitu aparicārako pitari micchā caritvāna nirayaṃ so upapajjati.
ja532:83.1: Dhan' āpi dhanakāmānaṃ nassati, iti me sutaṃ, mātaraṃ aparicaritvāna kicchaṃ vā so nigacchati.
ja532:84.1: Dhanam pi dhanakāmānaṃ nassati, iti me sutaṃ, pitaraṃ aparicaritvāna kicchaṃ vā so nigacchati.
ja532:85.1: Ānando ca pamādo ca sadā hasitakīḷitaṃ mātaraṃ paricaritvāna labbham etaṃ vijānato.
ja532:86.1: Ānando ca pamādo ca sadā hasitākīḷitaṃ pitaraṃ paricaritvāna labbham etaṃ vijānato.
ja532:87.1: Dānañ ca peyyavāsañ ca atthacariyā ca yā idha samānattā ca dhammesu tattha tattha yathārahaṃ, Ete kho saṅghā loke rathassāṇīva yāyato,
ja532:88.1: ete va saṅgahā nāssu na mātā puttakāraṇā. Labhetha mānaṃ pūjañ ca pitā va puttakāraṇā,
ja532:89.1: yasmā ca saṅgahā ete samavekkhanti paṇḍitā Tasmā mahattaṃ papponti pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te,
ja532:90.1: Brahmā hi nātāpitaro pubbācariyā ti vuccare. Āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ pajāya anukampakā,
ja532:91.1: tasmā hi te namasseyya sakkareyyātha paṇḍito. Annena-m-atho pānena vatthena sayanena ca ucchādanena nahāpanena pādānaṃ dhovanena ca,
ja532:92.1: Tāya naṃ paricariyāya mātāpitusu paṇḍitā idha c' eva [naṃ] pasaṃsanti pecca sagge ca modatīti.
